rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=1200, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-2: ONE knob -> n_iter 400->1200 (per-scan Adam steps, 3x). Failure mode from iter-1: val_score 0.4785, headroom 0.0, PSNR 16.13 < LD-FBP baseline 16.67 (under baseline). Hypothesis: the per-scan self-supervised U-Net N2I fit UNDER-CONVERGES at 400 steps on each val scene's own 128-view measurements; the per-image objective had not settled, so the recon was still far from its FBP-bounded optimum. iter-1 used only 250s wall (3000 total steps in 249.97s ~= 0.083 s/step), leaving huge headroom under the 1200s outer_wall_s and 1800s sbatch wall. Tripling per-scan steps lets each scan's own-measurement fit converge. New step budget: warm 3x200=600 + per-image 6x1200=7200 = 7800 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 650s, still under outer_wall_s=1200 and the 00:30:00 sbatch wall. All other knobs UNCHANGED from iter-1 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, lr=1e-3, unet_c=16, seed=42). Expectation: SSIM rises toward/above the LD-FBP baseline as the per-scan fit converges; N2I remains structurally FBP-bounded on this dense-view 128-angle phantom substrate (solver_plan.md), so a small positive headroom or a clean approach-to-baseline is the success signal, not a large jump.
